messages:
jenna_pm: quick sync — proposing a new 'elastic buffer' feature for reserved pools. goal: give customers a small, predictable burst cushion without forcing larger committed commits. want to align on launch criteria and what we ask legal/billing to accept.

sam_platform: can you sketch the user-facing knobs? we need something that maps cleanly to existing quota UI.

jenna_pm: idea: two numbers — reserve_size (committed) + buffer_pct (percent of reserve that can be used as temporary burst). buffer is non-billable until used, then billed at a premium rate. default buffer_pct = 10%.

laura_prod: i like that. major product question: does buffer expire monthly or roll over? also need clear failback order when pool is exhausted.

mike_sre: from ops side, spillover policy matters. prefer deterministic spill: first route to tenant fallback -> then to shared on-demand pool -> then throttle. need cooldown/hysteresis to avoid flapping.

anya_sales: customers asking for “guaranteed short bursts” for launches (esp ad-hoc traffic). billing premium is fine but needs clear SLA wording. also ask: can buffer be add-on or included in reserved tiers?

jenna_pm: launch checklist draft: product model, UI, billing terms, SLA language, preempt policy + fallback matrix, observable metrics (burst_util, spill_count, latency_p99 during bursts), oncall playbook, and docs.

sam_platform: technical perf constraints: buffer introduces short-lived overcommit. propose controls: per-pool concurrency cap, max burst QPS, and autoscale hysteresis (cool_down_s: 240 default). here's a sample config snippet we discussed:

```yaml
pool_id: beta-1
reserve_items: 1000
buffer_pct: 12
buffer_expiry: monthly
spill_policy: backfill_to_on_demand
autoscale:
  cooldown_s: 240
  hysteresis: 0.2
```

mike_sre: +1 to cooldown. also add a circuit-breaker: if spill_count > 10 in 5m -> force reject low-priority requests for 2m.

laura_prod: product question: what are the customer-facing metrics we show? propose: committed_capacity, available_buffer, buffer_used, expected_cost_delta. must be clear to avoid angry finance teams.

anya_sales: can we prototype as 'beta addon' for a few key customers? i have two pilots who would sign up if we support 5min burst windows and predictable billing.

jenna_pm: yes let's pilot. need acceptance criteria: 1) successful pilot with 2 customers 2) no more than 5 incidents attributable to buffer behavior in 30 days 3) metrics and billing audit pass 4) oncall runbook tested in canary.

sam_platform: dev tasks: implement buffer accounting & spill routing, UI knobs + API params, throttle/circuit breaker, telemetry tags (pool, buffer_used, spill_reason). estimate: 3 sprints for core + 1 sprint for docs & billing integration.

mike_sre: ops tasks: build alert for buffer_util > 70% and spill_rate > 1/min, prepare rollback steps.

jenna_pm: decision asks: (A) approve pilot work (B) default buffer_pct=10% and monthly expiry (C) bill buffer at 1.5x on-demand rate when consumed. any objections?

laura_prod: no objections, but add an opt-out toggle for finance teams.

anya_sales: +1 pilot. i'll line up customers and draft contract addendum.

sam_platform: +1 for the technical plan. will prioritize next sprint.

opsbot: deploy-bot: noted. created issue #PRD-4823 for "reserved-pool-elastic-buffer" and scheduled kickoff on sprint-2026-04-05.

jenna_pm: thanks all — i'll copy this into the roadmap doc and pull in billing/legal for contract wording. will follow up with a short spec in product/roadmap.
